result.summary: The landlord hasn't approved the first estimate. They've asked for a second contractor's quote to compare against it. I emailed them to say we'll get a second quote and that no work goes ahead until they choose one. I also told them that our last email had the check-out inspection report attached instead of the estimate. Picking and instructing a second contractor, and finding the missing first estimate, need a person at the agency, so I've passed the case to the human queue and put it on hold until we get the second quote.

No second contractor is on record and I can't see the first estimate, so someone at the agency has to source the quote. I let the landlord know so they aren't left waiting.
